scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Congratulations.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神官]
恭喜。
向勇士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Through the power
of holiness, may we
find peace, strength
and protection. Deliver
us from the forces of evil...
scripts.translation:
[神官]
願神聖之力賜予我們和平、力量與庇護，讓我們免受邪惡侵害...

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Our world is in
need of people of
talent and conviction.
Please continue your
good works as an even
greater hero of holiness...
scripts.translation:
[神官]
這個世界需要有才幹、有信念的人。
願你成為更偉大的神聖英雄，繼續行善...

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Would you like
to become a High Priest?

[High Priest]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神官]
準備好了，隨時回來吧。
向勇士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[神官]
你還有可以學習的技能。
請用完剩餘的技能點，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Congratulations.
As a High Priest,
I hope you will guide
others upon the path
to holiness...
scripts.translation:
[神官]
恭喜。
願你身為神官，引領他人走上神聖之路...

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[神官]
歡迎來到榮耀之廳——英靈殿。

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神官]
在這裡安心休息吧。
向勇士們致敬！
